text: SILVA SCORES AGAIN! It all starts with a superb cross-field pass from Doku to pick out Silva's free run down the right.
He plays another early cross into the box, but this one is weighted perfectly, and Sinisterra drags it around Walker before sliding it into the back of the net.

narrative_context: sudden late moment with little build-up
text: AKE SCORES! It's more great link-up play from City down their right side and Nunes slides it into Bobb at the byline.
He's in the middle of a crowd, but he gets into a pocket of space before stroking it past Radu into the back of the net.

SILVA SCORES! And just like that, City have doubled their lead! It's more wonderful play from Doku, who links up well with Walker down the right before leaving Mepham in a spin with some clever footwork.
DOKU SCORES! It's a lovely goal by City! Radu punches away Walker's cross, but the hosts quickly win it back once more.
AKANJI SCORES! It's City's seventh corner, and Bournemouth haven't dealt with it whenever it's been played short to Silva.

narrative_context: sudden late moment with little build-up
text: SAVE! City almost make a grandstand finish as Lewis slides a wonderful pass through Bournemouth's backline to pick out Kovacic's run.
SAVE! Silva has three defenders in front of him, but he squeezes a pass through to Alvarez before continuing his run, drawing Bournemouth players to him.
OFF THE POST! Silva checks back twice, but just can't open up space for a shot so he tees up Alvarez for a cross.
CHANCE! Doku dances into the box once more, but Senesi slides in to put it out for another corner.
CHANCE! It's much better from Bournemouth as they catch City out with a quick break, but Scott kicks through Rodri when the Spaniard cuts the cross out.
